stable.headline: Notes: leave them on the model, answer, edit and resolve them, and send the scene with everything inside.
notes: Notes: press N and click a spot on the model to leave a note.
Anyone can reply, edit, resolve or delete; every change carries the name of who made it.
An edit keeps what it replaced, and each note has a history.
Notes are saved in the scene file; exports never contain them.
Bring in the notes of another copy of the scene, and save a report page anyone can open.
The Notes card lists, filters and searches them.
